leave.deleteNote: {{name}} goes to Deleted, where you can restore them until they're purged. Every sign-in ends now, and API keys they made stop working.
leave.removeNote: {{name}} loses their roles and groups here, and their sessions, app sign-ins and API keys here end. Their account stays with the organisation that manages it.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.description: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in until reactivated, and API keys they made stop working. Their account, roles, groups and history are kept.

signOut.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
signOut.description: Every session they have ends, in every app and organisation, with their app sign-ins, remembered devices and unused sign-in links. An app that checks tokens itself may accept one for a few more minutes.

resetTwoStep.title: Reset {{name}}'s two-step verification?
resetTwoStep.description: Their authenticator app, recovery codes, text and email codes and linked phones are removed, and their remembered devices forgotten. Passkeys and sessions stay. They're emailed, and can set a second step up again when they next sign in.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: They go to Deleted, where you can restore them until they're purged. They're signed out everywhere now and API keys they made stop working; restoring them brings no session back.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from {{org}}?
remove.description: Their roles and groups here go, and their sessions, app sign-ins and API keys in {{org}} end. Their account stays with the organisation that manages it.

takeRole.title: Take {{role}} away from {{name}}?
takeRole.description: They lose what {{role}} allows at once, unless one of their groups gives it too.

leaveGroup.title: Remove {{name}} from {{group}}?
leaveGroup.description: They lose the roles {{group}} gives, unless they have them another way.

forget.title: Forget {{device}}?
forget.description: It asks {{name}} for a second step again at the next sign-in.

forgetAll.title: Forget all of {{name}}'s remembered devices?
forgetAll.description: Each one asks {{name}} for a second step again at the next sign-in.

removePhone.title: Remove {{phone}} from {{name}}'s account?
removePhone.description: It stops approving their sign-ins at once. Their other second steps stay.

access.rolesNote: What you give {{name}} in {{org}} yourself. Their groups can give more.
access.groupsNote: Members get every role their group gives; people in the groups inside it don't.
access.permissionsNote: {{direct}} from roles given directly; {{inherited}} only through groups.
access.noPermissions: {{name}} can't do anything in {{org}} yet: give them a role, or add them to a group that gives one.
access.noRoleRead: Seeing each permission needs the role.read permission.
access.policiesNote: A policy applies to anyone its conditions match.

security.twoStepNote: If {{name}} loses a device, reset it: every second step but passkeys is cleared, and they can set one up again.
security.recoveryNone: None left: if {{name}} loses their app, only a reset gets them in
security.alwaysRequireNote: Ask {{name}} for a second step at every sign-in, whatever the organisation's rule. With none set up, they set one up first.
security.alwaysOn: {{name}} is asked for a second step at every sign-in.
security.alwaysOff: {{name}} is asked for a second step when the organisation's rule says so.
security.phonesNote: Phones with Qeet Auth that approve {{name}}'s sign-ins. Remove a lost one; their other second steps stay.
security.passkeysNote: Sign-in with a face, fingerprint or device PIN, which counts as the second step too.
security.passwordNote: Send {{name}} a link to choose one, or set one yourself: setting it signs them out everywhere, and they're emailed.
security.devicesNote: These skip the second step until they expire.
security.connectedNote: Single sign-on, a directory or a social account they sign in with.
